job.source:
Job Title: Software Engineer: AI and Web3 Application Development

We are seeking a highly motivated Software Engineer to join our innovative team. The ideal candidate will have a strong foundation in Python and experience with AI/ML APIs, particularly in the context of Web3 applications. You will be involved in the full lifecycle of product development, from requirements gathering to deployment.

Responsibilities:
- Design, develop, and implement features for Web3 applications using Python.
- Integrate AI/LLM APIs to enhance application functionality.
- Collaborate with cross-functional teams to define, build, and ship new features.
- Perform data cleansing, standardization, and analysis to support application requirements.
- Write clean, maintainable, and well-documented code.
- Troubleshoot and debug existing systems.

Requirements:
- Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field.
- Proficiency in Python programming.
- Experience with API integration and data handling.
- Familiarity with Web3 technologies and blockchain concepts.
- Strong problem-solving skills and attention to detail.
- Ability to work in a fast-paced environment and manage multiple priorities.

Nice-to-Have:
- Experience with front-end technologies (HTML, CSS, JavaScript).
- Knowledge of database systems (SQL).
- Experience with cloud platforms and DevOps tools.

Join us to contribute to cutting-edge projects at the intersection of AI, Web3, and traditional finance. This role offers opportunities to work with diverse teams and tackle challenging problems in a dynamic setting.
